title: Paloma Rewards Benefit: Extra Collection Days on a Cash Pickup Shortfall Re-issue
content:
Paloma Rewards members receive extra collection days when a short Cash Pickup payout is re-issued. The days follow the tier of the sender's Paloma Rewards membership whose status is active.

| Sender's active Paloma Rewards tier | Days added to the window of a re-issue of a shortfall |
|---|---|
| Paloma Rewards Gold, Paloma Rewards Platinum, Paloma Rewards Diamond or Paloma Rewards Elite | 10 |
| Paloma Rewards Blue or Paloma Rewards Silver | 5 |
| No active membership | none |

The days are whole calendar days added to the re-issue window, so they move its last day of collection later.

**Which record decides.** The deciding record is the sender's Paloma Rewards membership as recorded, and only a membership whose status is active counts. A membership that is not active gives no days.

## Examples (hypothetical senders)

| Sender | Days |
|---|---|
| Active Paloma Rewards Platinum member | 10 |
| Active Paloma Rewards Silver member | 5 |
| Former Gold member whose membership is no longer active | none |
| Never joined Paloma Rewards | none |
